transcript: Speaker A: My name is Shobit. I am here to take admission in class nine. My favorite subject is Mathematics. I enjoy playing games, watching movies and interacting with new people. Speaker B: અરે વાહ! શોભિત બેટા, આઠમું પાસ થઈને એટલી Fluent English. કેવી રીતે બેટા, કેવી રીતે? [Wow! Shobit, fluent English after just passing 8th grade? How, son, how?] Speaker A: English Seekho app ના કારણે, ma'am. [Because of English Seekho app, ma'am.] Speaker B: English Seekho app? આ શું છે? [English Seekho app? What is this?] Speaker A: English Seekho app Spoken English શીખવા માટેનું એક શ્રેષ્ઠ app છે હો. અહીં experts પાસેથી મેં એકદમ basic level થી word ને word જોડીને sentence બનાવતા શીખ્યું અને પછી તેને fluently English માં કેવી રીતે બોલવું તે ખૂબ સરળ ભાષામાં શીખ્યું છે. ત્યારબાદ AI Coach સાથે દરરોજ Spoken English ની practice કરીને મારી English ને ફરરાટેદાર બનાવી દીધી. હવે હું કોઈની સાથે પણ fluently English માં વાત કરી શકું છું. [English Seekho app is one of the best apps to learn Spoken English. Here, I learned from experts how to join words to make sentences from a very basic level, and then how to speak fluently in English in a very simple language. After that, by practicing Spoken English daily with the AI Coach, I made my English fluent. Now I can speak fluently in English with anyone.] Speaker B: અરે વાહ! I give you 50% scholarship on fees for your English. [Wow! I give you 50% scholarship on fees for your English.] Speaker A: Ma'am, "I give you" નહીં, "I will give you a 50% scholarship on the fees for your English." Ma'am, હવે તમે પણ English Seekho app download કરી જ લો. [Ma'am, not "I give you", "I will give you a 50% scholarship on the fees for your English." Ma'am, now you should also download the English Seekho app.] Speaker B: Shut up! હમણાં જ English Seekho app download કરું છું બેટા. [Shut up! I am downloading the English Seekho app right now, son.] Speaker C: Install Now પર ક્લિક કરો ને English Seekho એપ ડાઉનલોડ કરી લો. [Click on Install Now and download the English Seekho app.]
on_screen_text: English Seekho. Install Now. [English Seekho. Install Now.]
summary: A school principal is impressed by a student's fluent English during an admission interview. The boy credits the English Seekho app and even corrects the principal's grammar, prompting her to download the app.
